name: objects-hash-and-cat
setup:
git init -q -b main . &&
printf 'hello\n' > hello.txt &&
printf '' > empty.txt &&
printf 'no newline' > nonl.txt &&
git hash-object -w hello.txt > /dev/null &&
git hash-object -w empty.txt > /dev/null &&
git hash-object -w nonl.txt > /dev/null
probes: git cat-file -p $(git hash-object nonl.txt) | od -c | head -3
git cat-file -e $(git hash-object hello.txt); echo exit=$?

git add -A
probes: git update-index --chmod=-x run.sh && git ls-files -s run.sh
git update-index --chmod=+x plain.txt && git ls-files -s plain.txt

body line one
body line two' &&
git tag -a v1 -m 'annotated tag' HEAD &&
git tag light HEAD~1
probes: git rev-parse HEAD HEAD~1 HEAD^{tree} v1 v1^{} light
